query: Which additional moments (CDS-implied PDs, short-term funding run indicators, stress-test losses, takeover events) are most informative about uninsured debt pricing S and rollover risk?

response.query: Which additional moments (CDS-implied PDs, short-term funding run indicators, stress-test losses, takeover events) are most informative about uninsured debt pricing S and rollover risk?
response.answer: CDS-implied PDs, short-term funding run indicators, and stress-test losses are most informative about uninsured debt pricing and rollover risk. Takeover events provide less direct insight.
